name: Nidavellir

categories.label: Warriors: sum of Bravery Points
categories.labelVi: Chiến binh: tổng Điểm Dũng cảm
categories.hint: Add the Bravery Points shown on each Warrior card (and hero bonuses to this class).

categories.label: Warriors majority: add highest coin
categories.labelVi: Đa số Chiến binh: cộng đồng xu giá trị cao nhất
categories.hint: Most ranks in the Warrior column adds the value of your highest coin; all tied players add it.

categories.label: Hunters: number squared
categories.labelVi: Thợ săn: bình phương số lá
categories.hint: Bravery Value = number of Hunter ranks squared.

categories.label: Miners: Bravery Points x ranks
categories.labelVi: Thợ mỏ: tổng Điểm Dũng cảm x số bậc
categories.hint: Sum of Miner Bravery Points multiplied by the number of ranks in the Miner column.

categories.label: Blacksmiths: +3, +4, +5...
categories.hint: Number of Blacksmith ranks n gives 3+4+...+(n+2) = n(n+5)/2 (1=3, 2=7, 3=12...).

categories.label: Explorers: sum of Bravery Points
categories.labelVi: Nhà thám hiểm: tổng Điểm Dũng cảm

categories.label: Neutral heroes (command zone)
categories.labelVi: Anh hùng trung lập (khu chỉ huy)
categories.hint: Bravery Value of neutral hero cards in the Command zone, plus final-count bonuses from artifacts/heroes not already added to a class.

categories.label: Total value of gold coins
categories.labelVi: Tổng giá trị đồng xu vàng
categories.hint: Sum all your coins (including Royal Treasury coins and any transformed coins).

tiebreakers.description: No tiebreaker: tied players share the victory.

notes: family: auction-money (blind coin bidding for dwarf cards, final Bravery Value). Game ends after the Age 2 deck is exhausted. Majority for Distinctions/Warriors is by number of ranks, not Bravery Points; the highest-value coin is counted twice for the Warrior majority holder (once in coins, once as Warrior bonus). Hero/artifact bonuses that add to a class Bravery Points should be put in that class; class-specific coins/gems effects of the Thingvellir/Idavoll expansions are not modelled. Hunter table to 25 ranks and blacksmith sequence from the publisher summary.
